description: Truncation of entries appended after the last publication is not detected.
note: The honest limit, asserted rather than described. The anchor attested three entries; five existed; one was removed. Everything attested is still present, so the outcome is consistent and it is correct -- an anchor makes truncation detectable BEYOND the last publication, not detectable. This is why EVID-6a requires the window to be disclosed, and why publishing on every refusal is worth the cost: a refusal is rare, and it is the entry an adversary most wants inside this window.
